title: Sample efficiency of one-anchor spectral relation reconstruction
trusted_information: one exact query-incident edge sign; graph support and edge magnitudes
policy: For each K, estimate observed gauges by the top eigenvector sign of centered calibration covariance, orient query gauge using the one trusted edge, reconstruct all edge signs, then run 16 synchronous updates.
analysis: Report sign accuracy, true output accuracy and NMSE versus K. No K is selected from test results; this stage is a prespecified curve, not a single-threshold PASS/FAIL test.
